units.source_text: 柏木说着用巴掌连续敲打了几下长满青苔的石塔顶，

en.t: As he said this, Kashiwagi struck the moss-covered top of the stone pagoda several times in succession with the palm of his hand,

units.source_text: "石头或白骨，都是人死后囹下的无机的部分。"

en.t: "Stone or white bones are both the inorganic parts left behind after a person dies."
